name: Pending PDCs
query: SELECT name AS "PDC:Link/PDC:160", payment_entry AS "Payment Entry:Link/Payment Entry:180", customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer:180", cheque_no AS "Cheque No:Data:140", amount AS "Amount:Currency:120", reference_date AS "Reference Date:Date:120", pdc_status AS "Status:Data:140" FROM `tabPDC` WHERE docstatus = 1 AND pdc_status = 'Pending' ORDER BY reference_date ASC, modified DESC
